Export.unavailable: Downloading the video is temporarily unavailable.

progress.label: Preparing the video
progress.busy: The rendering service is busy: the video will start as soon as it is free.
progress.cancelled: The video is still being prepared: ask again to pick it up.

errors.failed: The video could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.
errors.lost: Following the preparation was interrupted. The video may still be preparing: try again to pick it up.
errors.notReady: This explanation is not ready yet: the video will be available once it has finished loading.
errors.unreachable: The request could not be sent. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.rateLimitedSeconds: You have asked for a lot of videos in a short time. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
errors.rateLimitedMinutes: You have asked for a lot of videos in a short time. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.rateLimitedLater: You have asked for a lot of videos in a short time. Try again a little later.
